title: Migrate plugins/agent/monitor to contract v2
goal: Move the monitor plugin's result, disposition, budgets, and inputs onto contract v2 (#1821-#1826, #1829) while keeping config/templates/deployed.yaml dispatch behavior-identical for a passing run

steps.description: Declare v2 metadata in the manifest: provides.result_contract: 2; config.router: {timeout_s: 300, max_turns: 10} (Pattern-1 single-shot headroom, mirrors review-lens/manifest.yaml's identical comment); a one-line comment recording that no release/cleanup hook is declared because monitor holds no live resources (ADR-001 — absence is recorded, not implied; the engine's plugin.cleanup.absent event covers this automatically). valid_verdicts (pass,degraded), the primary:true monitor_report output, provides.role, and provides.events are already present — leave them.

Test-first: extend monitor-test.sh with failing SPECs before touching plugin.sh — assert .result_contract==2 and .disposition=="complete" on the existing dry-run/live-pass paths, .disposition mapped via router_reason_disposition on a model-call error, a new SPEC for SIGTERM/SIGINT during the model call writing disposition:"interrupted", and a new SPEC for router rc=10 (turn-budget exhaustion) writing disposition:"out_of_turns" reason:"budget_exhausted" (core/pipeline/disposition.sh documents "exhausted" as retired by #2187 — the issue's own ADR-063 §3 citation of disposition:exhausted/disposition.sh:97 is stale against current code; out_of_turns is the live equivalent and is what triggers route.sh's retry-at-+50%-capped-at-2x path). Run each new/changed assertion and confirm it fails for the intended reason before step-3.

Replace _monitor_write_report with a v2 result writer (_monitor_write_result), mirroring _review_lens_write_result: emit {result_contract:2, verdict, disposition, reason, data:{summary, checks}} via jq (never string-interpolated), folding today's rendered summary/checks strings into the namespaced data block per the issue's 'Folds in' section. Keep atomic_write.

Source scripts/lib/router-rc-classify.sh and wire disposition on every exit path of monitor_stage_run: dry-run and healthy-model paths -> "complete"; route_to_model rc!=0 -> router_reason_disposition(classified reason); unparseable/schema-gate-failed envelope -> "unusable"; a well-formed "degraded" verdict -> "complete" (the stage ran fine; the verdict itself communicates degradation). Every rc ∈ {0,1} per #1823 — no other exit code leaves the plugin. All SPEC-2..4 assertions from step-2 must pass.

Add a SIGTERM/SIGINT trap around the route_to_model call (mirrors _review_lens_interrupt_handler) that writes disposition:"interrupted" via _monitor_write_result and exits 1; add an explicit branch for router rc==10 that writes disposition:"out_of_turns" reason:"budget_exhausted" and returns 1, so the engine's existing out_of_turns retry response actually gets exercised for monitor for the first time.

Add ADR-063 §1 budget-guidance text to the prompt before the route_to_model call, modeled on review-lens's _review_lens_budget_guidance/_wallclock_guidance: read the effective limits via _route_resolve_max_turns and _route_resolve_timeout (core/router/route.sh) — never a hand-copied literal — and append a 'you have a BOUNDED tool-call budget' + wall-clock-target block so the model is told its actual turn/timeout limits sourced from step-1's manifest router block.

Delete the hardcoded deploy_result_json/pr_url_txt path construction in plugin.sh in favor of reading them from $ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS (engine-resolved name-matched inputs per #1825/#1826), matching design/plugin.sh's read-then-fallback pattern so existing fixtures without ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS set keep working. Confirm via `grep -n 'artifact_dir.*deploy-result\|artifact_dir.*pr-url' plugins/agent/monitor/plugin.sh` that no path construction remains, per the acceptance checklist's 'assert by grep' item.

Extend the deployed.yaml e2e test's existing behavior-unchanged golden check to assert the new v2 fields (result_contract:2, disposition:"complete") are present on a passing monitor dry-run, alongside the pre-existing verdict/monitor-report.json assertions — the before/after golden diff the acceptance checklist requires. A `grep -rl 'monitor-report.json\|monitor_stage_run\|monitor-summary.md' tests/` found only this file plus monitor-test.sh, so this is the complete additional test scope.

notes: monitor is already dispatched live in config/templates/deployed.yaml (pr->deploy->validate->monitor) and its manifest already declares valid_verdicts, a primary:true output, provides.role, and provides.events — the issue's own acceptance checklist anticipates this ('if this plugin already declares one, say so and move on'), so step-1 and step-8 are additive, not remedial; no template edit is needed for wiring. Confirmed directly against the manifest and plugin.sh in this pass (not just the prior checkpoint): manifest has no result_contract or config.router block yet; plugin.sh's _monitor_write_report writes only {schema_version,verdict,summary,checks} with no disposition/reason, no budget-guidance text, no SIGTERM/INT trap, and no rc=10 handling — matching the checkpoint's findings. Deviation from the issue text, flagged for human sign-off: the issue's 'ALSO LAND HERE' section directs disposition:"exhausted" citing disposition.sh:97->escalate and route.sh:749's +50%-capped-at-2x retry; core/pipeline/disposition.sh's own header states "exhausted" was retired by #2187 because it mapped to an unimplemented 'escalate' action and hid which budget (turns vs wall-clock) ran out. The current closed disposition set uses out_of_turns for turn exhaustion (both retried), and scripts/lib/router-rc-classify.sh's router_reason_disposition confirms router_out_of_turns -> out_of_turns; review-lens/plugin.sh already implements this exact rc==10 -> out_of_turns pattern end-to-end. This plan follows the current, working vocabulary per the CLAUDE.md anti-drift rule (spec/code wins over a stale issue citation) rather than the issue's literal 'exhausted' text — a human should confirm this correction before merge. Cleanup/release: no plugin.sh code changes planned since monitor holds no live resources to release; step-1's manifest comment plus the engine's existing plugin.cleanup.absent auto-emit is treated as satisfying that acceptance line. Router-budget values (timeout_s:300/max_turns:10) are proposed by analogy to review-lens's identical Pattern-1 comment, not independently derived from monitor-specific load data — no such data was available to read in this planning pass.
